_description: Phrases that signal the operator did not follow the agent's last message. ccgm-output-metrics applies them to a short follow-up prompt (<= 300 chars, not a slash command) and to a free-text AskUserQuestion answer. A text matches when the phrase starts it or makes up at least half of it. Texts are lowercased, curly apostrophes become straight, and surrounding punctuation is trimmed before matching. Every pattern carries examples; the test suite requires each example to match.

patterns.name: what_do_you_mean
patterns.description: Operator asks what the agent meant.
examples: What do you mean by that

patterns.name: dont_understand
patterns.description: Operator says they do not understand.

patterns.name: what_context
patterns.description: Operator asks what context a question or message rests on.
examples: What context are you talking about

patterns.name: lost_me
patterns.description: Operator says the agent lost them.

patterns.name: too_long
patterns.description: Operator says the message is too long.
